card.title: Getting started with Kazi
card.subtitle: Complete these steps to set up your organisation
card.allComplete: You're all set! Your organisation is ready to go.
card.dismissConfirm: Are you sure? This can't be undone.

create_project.label: Open your first matter
create_project.description: Matters are where your team organises work, records time, and manages documents.

log_time.label: Record time on a task
log_time.description: Time recording powers fee notes, fee estimates, and profitability reports.

create_invoice.label: Issue your first fee note
create_invoice.description: Pull recorded time into a fee note. Send it to your client directly from Kazi.

add_customer.label: Add a client
add_customer.description: Clients are the people and organisations you act for. Link them to matters for billing.

setup_rates.label: Set up your billing rates
setup_rates.description: Define billing and cost rates to enable profitability tracking and accurate fee notes.

invite_member.label: Invite a team member
invite_member.description: Collaboration is better together. Invite colleagues to start working as a team.
